title: How to Stop Package Theft in an Apartment Building (Video)

findings.quote: Cameras record package theft. Controlling where packages land is what prevents it.
findings.root_cause: STD-HONEST / EVD-CITATION-REQUIREMENT: the intro, coverage list, takeaway and script repeat an unsupported absolute prevention contrast. The parent table concedes camera deterrence and shared-code risk. This is procedural certainty, not individualized legal advice. See 10023-F01.
findings.fix:
Replace the intro with: "Controlling access to deliveries can reduce opportunities for package theft. Cameras can document incidents and may deter theft. This video explains practical options for older East Bay apartment buildings."
Replace "Why cameras don't stop package theft" with "Why cameras work best alongside controlled access".
Replace the first takeaway with: "Start with the delivery area and who can reach it; use cameras as one layer of protection."
Use the exact revised opening proposed in 10023-F01 for both Video Script blocks. Remove any "rarely prevent it" or assured-prevention phrasing from the companion copy.
findings.future_prevention: Check every video surface after article revisions, including intro, bullet lists and script.

findings.quote: 🎥 Video in production. It will appear here once it's live.
findings.root_cause: GATE-TECHNICAL-SEO: no finished recording, YouTube embed or verified literal transcript is present. This is a production dependency rather than a claim the draft was supposed to be finished. Draft preview returned HTTP 404; emitted schema, canonical, responsive rendering and editor validation remain unverified. Category 629, required template, image and SEO metadata are present.
findings.fix: Keep the accurate in-production notice while drafting. At launch replace it with the finished video's actual lite_youtube shortcode in a native wp:shortcode block. Retain "Video Script" until checked against the recording/SRT; then use "Video Transcript" only if it is literal. Verify the real companion URL, parent link, emitted VideoObject where applicable, canonical and responsive page before clearing this finding. No final shortcode can be supplied truthfully until a real video ID exists.
findings.future_prevention: Track recording, embed and rendered-page verification as launch requirements separate from script review.

findings.quote: A keypad package room with a changeable code fits most older buildings.
findings.root_cause: VIDEO-CONSISTENCY / EVD-CITATION-REQUIREMENT: the takeaway turns the article's labeled professional judgment into an unqualified claim about most buildings. Also, the script says not to buzz in anyone who says they have a delivery while the page correctly qualifies this as unexpected deliveries. Both scripts match each other, but these page-to-script shifts need correction.
findings.fix:
Replace the keypad takeaway with: "Professional opinion: consider a keypad package room where the layout, carrier access and applicable requirements allow it."
Replace the door takeaway with: "Strongly recommended best practice: check entry locks and make sure any existing door closer works reliably."
In both scripts replace "remind them not to buzz in anyone who says they have a delivery" with "remind them not to buzz in unexpected or unverified visitors, even if they claim to have a delivery".
findings.future_prevention: Compare body, takeaways and spoken script for lost qualifications; textual identity of two scripts is only one consistency check.
